```{r load_results, results='asis'}

# options(download.file.method = "libcurl")


main_dir <- params$main_dir
k <- params$k

if (is.null(main_dir) || !dir.exists(main_dir)) {
  stop("params$main_dir must identify an existing bNMF results directory.")
}

required_files <- c(
  "run_summary.txt", "df_traits.csv", "cluster_post_hoc.rds",
  "zmat_preImputed.rds", "zmat_imputed.rds", "rsID_map.txt"
)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(file.path(main_dir, required_files))]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Missing required report inputs: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
}

# main_dir = "./molecular_expression_signatures/NAFLD/bNMF/NAFLD_250211_v8_results"


# find majority K from run summary
df_run_summary <- fread(file.path(main_dir,"run_summary.txt"),
                        stringsAsFactors = F, data.table = F)


trait_results <- fread(file.path(main_dir, "df_traits.csv"))


k_counts <- df_run_summary %>% dplyr::count(K) %>%
  mutate(perc = n/nrow(df_run_summary))

run_sum_max <- df_run_summary %>%
  group_by(K) %>%
  summarise(convergence = min(evid, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(K=as.factor(K))


cluster_post_hoc <- readRDS(file.path(main_dir, "cluster_post_hoc.rds"))
zmat_final <- readRDS(file.path(main_dir, "zmat_preImputed.rds"))  %>%
  data.frame()
zmat_imputed <- readRDS(file.path(main_dir, "zmat_imputed.rds")) %>%
  data.frame()

w_mat <- cluster_post_hoc$w
h_mat <- cluster_post_hoc$h
cutoff_w <- if (!is.null(cluster_post_hoc$cutoff_w)) {
  cluster_post_hoc$cutoff_w
} else {
  cluster_post_hoc$cutoff
}
# Backward-compatible W alias used by older report sections and helpers.
cutoff <- cutoff_w

# Only results produced by the signed H rule are treated as current. Objects
# from the earlier combined-pair (sqrt(pos^2 + neg^2)) rule, or from before any
# H core rule, are flagged as legacy rather than silently presented.
has_h_core_results <- all(vapply(
  c("h_core_traits", "h_core_signed_traits", "h_trait_loadings", "h_relative_max_threshold"),
  function(name) !is.null(cluster_post_hoc[[name]]),
  logical(1)
)) && identical(cluster_post_hoc$h_selection_method, "H_signed_relative_to_cluster_maximum")
h_relative_max_threshold <- if (has_h_core_results) {
  as.numeric(cluster_post_hoc$h_relative_max_threshold)
} else {
  NA_real_
}
h_core_traits <- if (has_h_core_results) {
  as_tibble(cluster_post_hoc$h_core_traits)
} else {
  NULL
}
h_core_signed_traits <- if (has_h_core_results) {
  as_tibble(cluster_post_hoc$h_core_signed_traits)
} else {
  NULL
}
h_trait_loadings <- if (has_h_core_results) {
  as_tibble(cluster_post_hoc$h_trait_loadings)
} else {
  NULL
}
h_core_cluster_summary <- if (has_h_core_results &&
                              !is.null(cluster_post_hoc$h_core_cluster_summary)) {
  as_tibble(cluster_post_hoc$h_core_cluster_summary)
} else {
  NULL
}


if (is.null(k)) {
  k <- cluster_post_hoc$k
} else if (!identical(as.integer(k), as.integer(cluster_post_hoc$k))) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Requested K=%s, but cluster_post_hoc.rds contains K=%s. Re-run do_post_analysis() for the requested K or render with k=NULL.",
    k, cluster_post_hoc$k
  ))
}
cluster_names <- cluster_post_hoc$cluster_names

# Run the stability analysis on demand.  Its input is the saved full set of
# bNMF repetitions, so no clustering is repeated during report rendering.
stability_dir <- file.path(main_dir, "stability_analysis")
stability_summary_path <- file.path(stability_dir, "stability_per_cluster.csv")
stability_table <- NULL
stability_note <- NULL

if (file.exists(stability_summary_path)) {
  stability_table <- read.csv(stability_summary_path, check.names = FALSE)
} else if (!file.exists(file.path(main_dir, "bnmf_out.rds"))) {
  stability_note <- "Per-cluster stability was not calculated because bnmf_out.rds is unavailable."
} else {
  stability_script <- params$stability_script
  if (is.null(stability_script) || !nzchar(stability_script) || !file.exists(stability_script)) {
    stability_script <- file.path(dirname(dirname(normalizePath(helper_script))),
                                  "assess_bNMF_stability.R")
  }

  if (!file.exists(stability_script)) {
    stability_note <- "Per-cluster stability was not calculated because assess_bNMF_stability.R could not be located."
  } else {
    stability_output <- tryCatch(
      system2(
        file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
        args = c(shQuote(stability_script), shQuote(main_dir)),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    stability_status <- if (inherits(stability_output, "error")) 1L else {
      status <- attr(stability_output, "status")
      if (is.null(status)) 0L else status
    }

    if (stability_status == 0L && file.exists(stability_summary_path)) {
      stability_table <- read.csv(stability_summary_path, check.names = FALSE)
    } else {
      stability_note <- paste0(
        "Automatic per-cluster stability analysis did not complete. ",
        "See the render log for details."
      )
      warning(stability_note)
      if (is.character(stability_output)) message(paste(stability_output, collapse = "\n"))
    }
  }
}

domain_fallback <- match.arg(params$domain_fallback, c("grep", "other"))
trait_groups_path <- file.path(main_dir, "trait_groups.csv")
trait_groups <- if (file.exists(trait_groups_path)) {
  read_csv(trait_groups_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  NULL
}

w_mat_long <- w_mat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=cluster_names, names_to='cluster',values_to='weight')

has_chr_prefix <- startsWith(w_mat$variant[1],"chr")

df_rsid <- fread(file.path(main_dir,"rsID_map.txt"),
                        stringsAsFactors = F, data.table = F)  %>%
  separate(VAR_ID, into=c("CHR","POS","REF","ALT"),sep = "_",remove = F) %>%
  mutate(variant = if(has_chr_prefix) {
                     paste0("chr", CHR, ":", POS)
                   } else {
                     paste(CHR, POS, sep=":")
                   }) %>%
  distinct(variant, .keep_all = TRUE)


h_mat_long_raw <- h_mat %>% t() %>% data.frame() %>%
  set_colnames(cluster_names) %>%
  rownames_to_column('trait') %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=cluster_names, names_to='cluster',values_to='weight')

# Current post-processing objects contain one row per SELECTED SIGNED column
# and cluster. A bidirectional trait therefore contributes both its positive and
# negative component to directional displays, while make_signed_trait_summary()
# groups rows by base trait so each trait is counted once. Older objects retain
# the historical behavior and are clearly flagged in the report.
if (has_h_core_results) {
  h_mat_long <- h_core_signed_traits %>%
    transmute(
      trait = signed_trait,
      cluster,
      weight,
      base_trait,
      relative_to_maximum,
      core_selected = TRUE
    )
  w_mat_interpretation <- w_mat_long %>% filter(weight >= cutoff_w)
  interpretation_cutoff <- 0
  n_base_traits <- dplyr::n_distinct(h_trait_loadings$base_trait_id)
} else {
  h_mat_long <- h_mat_long_raw
  w_mat_interpretation <- w_mat_long
  interpretation_cutoff <- cutoff_w
  n_base_traits <- ncol(h_mat) / 2
}

w_mat_final <- w_mat_long %>% filter(weight >= cutoff_w)

variant_annotations <- df_rsid %>%
  distinct(variant, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(variant, VAR_ID, rsID, REF, ALT)

aligned_path <- file.path(main_dir, "alignment_GWAS_summStats.csv")
if (file.exists(aligned_path)) {
  # Older runs used a tab-delimited .csv and did not always include VAR_ID.
  # fread() detects the delimiter, and the most reliable available identifier
  # is selected in descending order of specificity.
  aligned_gwas <- fread(
    aligned_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    data.table = FALSE
  )
  alignment_key <- if ("VAR_ID" %in% names(aligned_gwas)) {
    "VAR_ID"
  } else if ("rsID" %in% names(aligned_gwas)) {
    "rsID"
  } else if ("ChrPos" %in% names(aligned_gwas)) {
    aligned_gwas <- aligned_gwas %>%
      mutate(
        variant = if (has_chr_prefix) {
          paste0("chr", sub("^chr", "", as.character(ChrPos), ignore.case = TRUE))
        } else {
          sub("^chr", "", as.character(ChrPos), ignore.case = TRUE)
        }
      )
    "variant"
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }

  if (is.na(alignment_key)) {
    warning(
      "alignment_GWAS_summStats.csv has no VAR_ID, rsID, or ChrPos column; ",
      "primary-GWAS annotations will be omitted."
    )
  } else {
    aligned_gwas <- aligned_gwas %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[alignment_key]])) %>%
      distinct(.data[[alignment_key]], .keep_all = TRUE)
    aligned_keep <- intersect(
      c(alignment_key, "P_VALUE", "BETA_aligned", "Risk_Allele"),
      names(aligned_gwas)
    )
    variant_annotations <- variant_annotations %>%
      left_join(
        aligned_gwas %>% select(all_of(aligned_keep)),
        by = alignment_key
      )
  }
}

trait_concentration <- if (has_h_core_results) {
  h_trait_loadings %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      total_energy = sum(loading_energy, na.rm = TRUE),
      top_trait_share = if_else(
        total_energy > 0,
        max(loading_energy, na.rm = TRUE) / total_energy,
        NA_real_
      ),
      effective_traits = if_else(
        total_energy > 0,
        total_energy^2 / sum(loading_energy^2, na.rm = TRUE),
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
} else {
  NULL
}

cluster_interpretation <- make_cluster_interpretation(
  w_mat_long = w_mat_interpretation,
  h_mat_long = h_mat_long,
  cutoff = interpretation_cutoff,
  variant_annotations = variant_annotations,
  top_n = 8,
  trait_groups = trait_groups,
  domain_fallback = domain_fallback,
  trait_concentration = trait_concentration
)
cluster_overlap <- make_cluster_overlap_matrix(w_mat_long, cutoff)


k_perc <- k_counts$perc[k_counts$K == k]
if (!length(k_perc)) stop("Selected K is absent from run_summary.txt.")
  
cat("\n\n## ", sprintf("Variant x Trait matrix = %i SNPs x %i Traits\n", nrow(w_mat), n_base_traits), "\n")
cat("\n\n## ", sprintf("bNMF converged to %i clusters in %.0f%% of iterations\n", k, k_perc*100), "\n")
```

```{r run_metadata, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
meta_df <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Results directory", "Selected K", "K frequency",
            "SNPs", "Traits", "W/SNP cutoff", "H interpretation rule",
            "Report generated"),
  Value = c(
    basename(main_dir),
    k,
    sprintf("%.0f%% of iterations", k_perc * 100),
    nrow(w_mat),
    n_base_traits,
    round(cutoff_w, 4),
    if (has_h_core_results) {
      sprintf("Signed loading >= %.0f%% of cluster maximum loading",
              100 * h_relative_max_threshold)
    } else {
      sprintf("Legacy shared W/H cutoff = %.4f", cutoff_w)
    },
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = "US/Eastern")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(meta_df, col.names = c("", "")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 13)
```

## Initial cluster interpretation

These labels are deterministic summaries of the strongest trait domains, not definitive biological subtype names. Positive and negative directions refer to trait effects aligned to the risk-increasing allele from the primary GWAS. “Effective” counts decrease when one component dominates the total weight.

```{r interpretation_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
overview_display <- cluster_interpretation$overview %>%
  mutate(
    effective_loci = round(effective_loci, 1),
    effective_traits = round(effective_traits, 1),
    shared_loci_percent = round(shared_loci_percent, 1),
    top_locus_share_percent = round(top_locus_share_percent, 1),
    top_trait_share_percent = round(top_trait_share_percent, 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Cluster = cluster,
    `Provisional signature` = provisional_label,
    Loci = n_loci,
    Traits = n_traits,
    `Effective loci` = effective_loci,
    `Effective traits` = effective_traits,
    `Shared loci (%)` = shared_loci_percent,
    `Top locus share (%)` = top_locus_share_percent,
    `Top trait energy share (%)` = top_trait_share_percent,
    Flags = interpretation_flag
  )

kable(overview_display, caption = "Cluster-level interpretation and concentration checks") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 11)
```

```{r per_cluster_stability, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (is.null(stability_table)) {
  cat("<div class='caveat-box'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(stability_note), "</div>\n")
} else {
  stability_display <- stability_table %>%
    transmute(
      Cluster = paste0("X", cluster),
      `Recovery >= 0.80` = scales::percent(recovery_rate_joint_ge_0_80, accuracy = 1),
      `Recovery >= 0.90` = scales::percent(recovery_rate_joint_ge_0_90, accuracy = 1),
      `Mean joint cosine` = round(mean_joint_cosine, 3),
      `5th percentile` = round(p05_joint_cosine, 3),
      `Within-cluster consensus` = round(mean_within_consensus, 3),
      `Stability flag` = stability_flag
    )

  cat("### Per-cluster reproducibility\n\n")
  cat("Clusters are aligned to the final solution using combined W/H cosine similarity across all saved bNMF repetitions.\n\n")
  print(
    kable(stability_display, caption = "Recovery and consensus of final clusters") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                    full_width = TRUE, font_size = 11)
  )
}
```

```{r previous_run_comparison, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
previous_main_dir <- params$previous_main_dir
if (!is.null(previous_main_dir) && nzchar(previous_main_dir)) {
  previous_posthoc_file <- file.path(previous_main_dir, "cluster_post_hoc.rds")
  if (!file.exists(previous_posthoc_file)) {
    cat("<div class='caveat-box'>Previous-run comparison requested, but cluster_post_hoc.rds was not found.</div>\n")
  } else {
    previous_posthoc <- readRDS(previous_posthoc_file)
    previous_h_long <- previous_posthoc$h %>%
      t() %>%
      data.frame() %>%
      set_colnames(previous_posthoc$cluster_names) %>%
      rownames_to_column("trait") %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(previous_posthoc$cluster_names),
                   names_to = "cluster", values_to = "weight")

    previous_matches <- compare_cluster_trait_profiles(h_mat_long_raw, previous_h_long) %>%
      mutate(cosine_similarity = round(cosine_similarity, 3)) %>%
      rename(
        `Current cluster` = current_cluster,
        `Best previous match` = previous_cluster,
        `Signed-trait cosine similarity` = cosine_similarity
      )

    cat("### Comparison with previous run\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("Previous results: `%s`\n\n", basename(previous_main_dir)))
    print(
      kable(previous_matches,
            caption = "Best previous cluster match by signed trait profile") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                      full_width = FALSE)
    )
    cat("\n<p><em>These are best matches, not one-to-one assignments; the same previous cluster may match more than one current cluster.</em></p>\n")
  }
}
```

## bNMF Algorithm Parameters

```{r hyperparams, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

library(dplyr)

# Extract and display bNMF hyperparameters
cat("This section reports the hyperparameters used in the Bayesian Non-negative Matrix Factorization (bNMF) clustering.\n\n")

# Try to load the saved bNMF settings
bnmf_settings_file <- file.path(main_dir, "bnmf_settings.rds")
if (file.exists(bnmf_settings_file)) {
  my_bNMF_settings <- readRDS(bnmf_settings_file)
  params_source <- "pipeline settings"
} else {
  # Fallback: try to infer from results
  my_bNMF_settings <- list(
    n_reps = ifelse(exists("df_run_summary"), nrow(df_run_summary), "Unknown"),
    K = ifelse(exists("k"), k, "Unknown"),
    K0 = "Unknown",
    tolerance = "Unknown", 
    phi = "Unknown"
  )
  params_source <- "inferred from results"
  cat("<p style='color: orange; font-weight: bold;'>Note: bNMF settings file not found. Showing inferred values.</p>\n\n")
}

# Parameter descriptions
param_descriptions <- list(
  n_reps = "Number of bNMF repetitions/iterations",
  K = "Maximum number of clusters",
  K0 = "Prior number of expected active clusters", 
  tolerance = "Convergence tolerance threshold",
  phi = "Regularization parameter (noise precision)"
)

# Build the parameters table
params_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(my_bNMF_settings),
  Value = sapply(my_bNMF_settings, function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      if (x < 0.01) sprintf("%.2e", x) else sprintf("%.3g", x)
    } else as.character(x)
  }),
  Description = sapply(names(my_bNMF_settings), function(p) {
    ifelse(p %in% names(param_descriptions), param_descriptions[[p]], "Algorithm parameter")
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Display the table
kable(params_df, 
      caption = paste("bNMF Algorithm Hyperparameters (", params_source, ")"),
      col.names = c("Parameter", "Value", "Description")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 14)

# Add a note about the final chosen K
if (exists("k")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n<p style='font-size: 14px; color: #2E86AB;'><strong>Final selected K:</strong> %d clusters (from %s repetitions)</p>\n", 
              k, 
              ifelse("n_reps" %in% names(my_bNMF_settings), my_bNMF_settings$n_reps, "multiple")))
}

```

## SNP Processing Summary

This section shows how we arrived at the final number of SNPs in the z-score matrix, tracking the filtering and proxy selection process.

```{r snp_processing_summary, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

# Try to load the various intermediate files that track SNP processing
# Initialize tracking data frame
snp_tracking <- data.frame(
  Step = character(),
  Count = integer(),
  Description = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Check if we can get proxy information from saved files or objects in workspace
total_pruned <- NA
total_needing_proxies <- NA  
total_proxies_found <- NA
variants_no_proxy <- NA

# 1. Try to load comprehensive summary first (most reliable)
snp_summary_file <- file.path(main_dir, "snp_tracking_summary.rds")
if (file.exists(snp_summary_file)) {
  snp_summary <- readRDS(snp_summary_file)
  
  snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
    Step = "Initial Pruned SNPs",
    Count = snp_summary$total_pruned,
    Description = "SNPs after LD pruning and initial filtering"
  ))
  
  snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
    Step = "SNPs Needing Proxies",
    Count = snp_summary$total_needing_proxies,
    Description = "SNPs requiring proxy variants (missing data or other issues)"
  ))
  
  if (snp_summary$total_proxies_found > 0) {
    snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
      Step = "Proxies Found",
      Count = snp_summary$total_proxies_found,
      Description = "Suitable proxy variants identified"
    ))
    
    # Add population breakdown if available
    if ("proxy_results_by_pop" %in% names(snp_summary)) {
      for (i in 1:nrow(snp_summary$proxy_results_by_pop)) {
        pop_row <- snp_summary$proxy_results_by_pop[i, ]
        if (pop_row$Proxies_found > 0) {
          snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
            Step = paste("  -", pop_row$Population, "population"),
            Count = pop_row$Proxies_found,
            Description = paste(pop_row$Proxies_found, "proxies found for", pop_row$Population)
          ))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (snp_summary$variants_no_proxy > 0) {
    snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
      Step = "SNPs Excluded (No Proxy)",
      Count = snp_summary$variants_no_proxy,
      Description = "SNPs excluded due to lack of suitable proxy"
    ))
  }
  
  tracking_source <- "comprehensive summary"
  
} else {
  # 2. Try to get data from individual files or workspace variables
  tracking_source <- "individual files/workspace"
  
  # Try to get counts from environment if available (from pipeline run)
  if (exists("pruned_vars")) {
    total_pruned <- nrow(pruned_vars)
    snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
      Step = "Initial Pruned SNPs",
      Count = total_pruned,
      Description = "SNPs after LD pruning and initial filtering"
    ))
  } else {
    # Try to load from file
    pruned_vars_file <- file.path(main_dir, "pruned_variants.rds")
    if (file.exists(pruned_vars_file)) {
      pruned_vars_loaded <- readRDS(pruned_vars_file)
      total_pruned <- nrow(pruned_vars_loaded)
      snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
        Step = "Initial Pruned SNPs",
        Count = total_pruned,
        Description = "SNPs after LD pruning and initial filtering"
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Try to get proxies needed info
  if (exists("proxies_needed")) {
    total_needing_proxies <- nrow(proxies_needed)
    snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
      Step = "SNPs Needing Proxies",
      Count = total_needing_proxies,
      Description = "SNPs requiring proxy variants (missing data or other issues)"
    ))
    
    # If proxies_needed has a 'reason' column, break down by reason
    if ("reason" %in% colnames(proxies_needed)) {
      proxy_reasons <- table(proxies_needed$reason)
      for (reason in names(proxy_reasons)) {
        snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
          Step = paste("  -", reason),
          Count = as.integer(proxy_reasons[reason]),
          Description = paste("SNPs needing proxy due to", reason)
        ))
      }
    }
  } else {
    # Try to load from file
    proxies_needed_file <- file.path(main_dir, "proxies_needed.rds")
    if (file.exists(proxies_needed_file)) {
      proxies_needed_loaded <- readRDS(proxies_needed_file)
      total_needing_proxies <- nrow(proxies_needed_loaded)
      snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
        Step = "SNPs Needing Proxies",
        Count = total_needing_proxies,
        Description = "SNPs requiring proxy variants"
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Try to get proxy results
  if (exists("proxy_results_by_pop")) {
    total_proxies_found <- sum(proxy_results_by_pop$Proxies_found, na.rm = TRUE)
    snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
      Step = "Proxies Found",
      Count = total_proxies_found,
      Description = "Suitable proxy variants identified"
    ))
    
    # Add population breakdown
    for (i in 1:nrow(proxy_results_by_pop)) {
      pop_row <- proxy_results_by_pop[i, ]
      if (pop_row$Proxies_found > 0) {
        snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
          Step = paste("  -", pop_row$Population, "population"),
          Count = pop_row$Proxies_found,
          Description = paste(pop_row$Proxies_found, "proxies found for", pop_row$Population)
        ))
      }
    }
  } else {
    # Try to load from file
    proxy_results_file <- file.path(main_dir, "proxy_results_summary.rds")
    if (file.exists(proxy_results_file)) {
      proxy_results_loaded <- readRDS(proxy_results_file)
      total_proxies_found <- sum(proxy_results_loaded$Proxies_found, na.rm = TRUE)
      snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
        Step = "Proxies Found",
        Count = total_proxies_found,
        Description = "Suitable proxy variants identified"
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate variants excluded
  if (!is.na(total_needing_proxies) && !is.na(total_proxies_found)) {
    variants_no_proxy <- total_needing_proxies - total_proxies_found
    if (variants_no_proxy > 0) {
      snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
        Step = "SNPs Excluded (No Proxy)",
        Count = variants_no_proxy,
        Description = "SNPs excluded due to lack of suitable proxy"
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Final count from actual matrix
final_count <- nrow(w_mat)
snp_tracking <- rbind(snp_tracking, data.frame(
  Step = "Final SNP Count",
  Count = final_count,
  Description = "SNPs in final z-score matrix for clustering"
))

# If we don't have detailed tracking info, provide basic info
if (nrow(snp_tracking) == 1) {
  snp_tracking <- data.frame(
    Step = c("SNPs in Z-Score Matrix", "Final SNP Count"),
    Count = c(final_count, final_count),
    Description = c("SNPs available in the final z-score matrix", 
                   "SNPs used for bNMF clustering")
  )
  cat("<p style='color: orange; font-weight: bold;'>Note: Detailed SNP tracking information not available. Showing final counts only.</p>\n\n")
  tracking_source <- "final matrix only"
} else {
  cat(sprintf("<p style='color: green; font-size: 12px;'><em>Data source: %s</em></p>\n\n", tracking_source))
}

# Display as a formatted table
kable(snp_tracking, 
      caption = "SNP Processing Pipeline Summary",
      col.names = c("Processing Step", "SNP Count", "Description")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 14) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(snp_tracking), bold = TRUE, background = "#E8F4FD")
```

```{r qc_report, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
qc_file <- file.path(main_dir, "quality_control_report.txt")
if (file.exists(qc_file)) {
  qc_lines <- readLines(qc_file)
  # Colour PASS green, FAIL red
  qc_html <- sapply(qc_lines, function(l) {
    if (grepl("PASS", l, fixed = TRUE)) {
      sprintf("<p style='margin:2px 0; font-family:monospace;'><span style='color:#006600; font-weight:bold;'>&#10004;</span> %s</p>", htmltools::htmlEscape(l))
    } else if (grepl("FAIL", l, fixed = TRUE)) {
      sprintf("<p style='margin:2px 0; font-family:monospace;'><span style='color:#cc0000; font-weight:bold;'>&#10008;</span> %s</p>", htmltools::htmlEscape(l))
    } else if (nchar(trimws(l)) == 0) {
      "<br>"
    } else {
      sprintf("<p style='margin:2px 0; font-family:monospace; color:#444;'>%s</p>", htmltools::htmlEscape(l))
    }
  })
  cat("<div style='background:#f8f8f8; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:5px; padding:15px; margin-bottom:15px;'>\n")
  cat(paste(qc_html, collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n</div>\n")
} else {
  cat("<p style='color:orange; font-weight:bold;'>quality_control_report.txt not found in results directory.</p>\n")
}
```

## Variant Quality Control

This section checks for ambiguous and multi-allelic SNPs in the final variant set.

```{r variant_qc, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

# Extract allele information from the variant matrix
# Check if we have rsID mapping with allele info
if (exists("df_rsid") && all(c("REF", "ALT") %in% colnames(df_rsid))) {
  
  # Get allele combinations for variants in the final matrix
  final_variants <- w_mat %>%
    left_join(df_rsid[, c("variant", "VAR_ID", "REF", "ALT")], by = "variant") %>%
    mutate(allele_combo = paste(REF, ALT, sep = "_"))

  mapped_variants <- final_variants %>% filter(!is.na(REF), !is.na(ALT))
  mapping_coverage <- nrow(mapped_variants) / nrow(final_variants)
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>Allele-map coverage:</strong> %d/%d variants (%.1f%%)</p>\n",
              nrow(mapped_variants), nrow(final_variants), 100 * mapping_coverage))
  if (mapping_coverage < 1) {
    cat("<div class='caveat-box'><strong>Incomplete QC coverage:</strong> variants without allele-map records cannot be classified as ambiguous or multiallelic. A clean result below applies only to mapped variants.</div>\n")
  }
  
  # Count each allele combination
  allele_counts <- table(mapped_variants$allele_combo)
  allele_summary <- data.frame(
    Allele_Combination = names(allele_counts),
    Count = as.numeric(allele_counts)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Count))
  
  # Check for ambiguous SNPs (A/T or C/G)
  ambiguous_combos <- c("A_T", "T_A", "C_G", "G_C")
  ambiguous_snps <- mapped_variants[mapped_variants$allele_combo %in% ambiguous_combos, ]
  
  # Check for multi-allelic SNPs (comma in ALT allele)
  multiallelic_snps <- mapped_variants[grepl(",", mapped_variants$ALT), ]
  
  # Display results
  cat("### Allele Combination Summary\n\n")
  
  # Print allele combination table
  kable(allele_summary, 
        caption = "Count of Each Allele Combination in Final Variant Set",
        col.names = c("Allele Combination (REF_ALT)", "Count")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    print()
  
  cat("\n\n")
  

  # Check for ambiguous SNPs
  if (nrow(ambiguous_snps) > 0) {
    cat("<div style='background-color: #ffcccc; border: 2px solid #ff0000; padding: 15px; margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 5px;'>\n")
    cat("<h4 style='color: #cc0000; margin-top: 0;'>&#9888; WARNING: AMBIGUOUS SNPs DETECTED!</h4>\n")  # ⚠️
    cat(sprintf("<p><strong>%d ambiguous SNPs found</strong> (A/T or C/G combinations)</p>\n", nrow(ambiguous_snps)))
    cat("<p>These SNPs may cause strand ambiguity issues in downstream analyses.</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("<div style='background-color: #ccffcc; border: 2px solid #00cc00; padding: 15px; margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 5px;'>\n")
    cat("<h4 style='color: #006600; margin-top: 0;'>&#10004; No ambiguous SNPs detected among mapped variants</h4>\n")
    cat("<p>No A/T or C/G SNP combinations were found among variants with allele annotations.</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
  
  # Check for multi-allelic SNPs
  if (nrow(multiallelic_snps) > 0) {
    cat("<div style='background-color: #ffcccc; border: 2px solid #ff0000; padding: 15px; margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 5px;'>\n")
    cat("<h4 style='color: #cc0000; margin-top: 0;'>&#9888; WARNING: MULTI-ALLELIC SNPs DETECTED!</h4>\n")  # ⚠️
    cat(sprintf("<p><strong>%d multi-allelic SNPs found</strong> (comma in ALT allele)</p>\n", nrow(multiallelic_snps)))
    cat("<p>These SNPs may cause issues with allele alignment in downstream analyses.</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("<div style='background-color: #ccffcc; border: 2px solid #00cc00; padding: 15px; margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 5px;'>\n")
    cat("<h4 style='color: #006600; margin-top: 0;'>&#10004; No multi-allelic SNPs detected among mapped variants</h4>\n")
    cat("<p>No multi-allelic SNPs were found among variants with allele annotations.</p>\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("<p style='color: orange; font-weight: bold;'>Note: Allele information not available for variant quality control check.</p>\n\n")
}
```

```{r trait_missingness1, echo = FALSE, results='asis', out.width=c('50%', '50%'), fig.show='hold'}
    Decile = paste0(seq(0, 90, 10), "-", seq(10, 100, 10), "%"),
    Observed_Range = paste0("[", round(observed_deciles[-11], 2), ", ", round(observed_deciles[-1], 2), "]"),
    Imputed_Range = paste0("[", round(imputed_deciles[-11], 2), ", ", round(imputed_deciles[-1], 2), "]")
  )

  print(

          caption = "Distribution comparison: observed vs imputed z-scores",
          col.names = c("Decile", "Observed values", "Imputed values")) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                    full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12)
  )

  extreme_imputed <- mean(abs(imputed_values) > 5)
  if (extreme_imputed > 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("\n<p style='color: orange; font-weight: bold;'>%.1f%% of imputed values are extreme (|z| > 5); review imputation parameters.</p>\n", extreme_imputed * 100))
  } else {
    cat("\n<p style='color: green;'>Imputed values show no excessive burden of |z| &gt; 5 values.</p>\n")
  }

  set.seed(123)
  density_df <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(value = sample(observed_values, min(50000, length(observed_values))), type = "Observed"),
    data.frame(value = sample(imputed_values, min(50000, length(imputed_values))), type = "Imputed")
  )
  print(
    ggplot(density_df, aes(x = value, fill = type)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = "steelblue", "Imputed" = "tomato")) +

      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = "Z-score", y = "Density",
           title = "Observed vs imputed z-score distributions", fill = NULL)
  )
}
```

### SNP membership and trait interpretation

The two factor matrices serve different downstream purposes and therefore use separate selection rules.

**SNP membership (W).** Method M pools all variant-by-cluster weights, normalizes rank and weight to the unit interval, fits an upper reference line to the top 0.2% (minimum 25 observations), and fits a lower reference line to the bottom 80%. The cutoff is the first observed weight closer to the lower line than to the upper line. This W cutoff defines cluster SNP membership and score weights.

**Trait interpretation (H).** Within each cluster, the original signed H columns (`trait_pos`, `trait_neg`, or unsigned) are each compared with 50% of that cluster's largest single loading, and every column at or above that threshold is selected. Selected columns are collapsed to base traits afterward; a trait with both its positive and negative column selected is labelled bidirectional. Positive and negative columns are never combined before thresholding. This scale-invariant rule is used for descriptive trait membership, domain summaries, circle plots, and filtered Z-matrix displays; it does not alter SNP score weights. Concentration flags (single-trait dominated) are computed from the full H loading profile, not from the size of the selected set.

<p style="font-size:14pt; font-weight:bold; color:red;">
    Method M W cutoff: `r round(cutoff_w, 4)`<br>
    H core threshold: `r if (has_h_core_results) paste0(round(100 * h_relative_max_threshold), "% of the cluster's largest single loading") else "legacy results object—signed H core traits unavailable"`
</p><br>

```{r h_selection_status, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!has_h_core_results) {
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class='caveat-box'><strong>Legacy H behavior.</strong> ",
    "This cluster_post_hoc.rds predates the signed relative-to-maximum H rule ",
    "(it has no signed core-trait table, or was produced by the earlier combined-pair rule). ",
    "Trait sections therefore use the historical shared W/H cutoff. Re-run ",
    "the updated do_post_analysis() to generate H core-trait results.</div>\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r post_hoc_analyses, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  n_traits[[cluster_name]] <- if (has_h_core_results) {

  } else {

      filter(cluster == cluster_name, magnitude >= cutoff_w) %>% nrow()
  }

}
```

## Cluster summary

Each section begins with the evidence used for the provisional interpretation: the defining signed traits, the defining loci with their soft-membership specificity, and the trait-domain composition, followed by the circular weight plot and the z-score heatmap for the cluster. Gene labels are the nearest gene to each variant.


```{r print_plots_refactored, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.width=16, fig.height=14, fig.show='asis', fig.keep='all'}
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)

# Define a single function to get a plot, handling potential NULL or non-ggplot objects
get_plot <- function(plot_list, cluster_name) {
  p <- plot_list[[cluster_name]]
  if (is.null(p)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    p <- as.ggplot(p)
  }
  return(p)
}

# Loop through each cluster
for (cluster in cluster_names) {
  # HTML heading and info
  overview_row <- cluster_interpretation$overview %>% filter(cluster == !!cluster)
  provisional_label <- overview_row$provisional_label[1]
  narrative <- cluster_interpretation$narratives[[cluster]]

  cat(sprintf("<h3 style='margin:20px 0;'>Cluster %s: %s</h3>\n",
              htmltools::htmlEscape(cluster),
              htmltools::htmlEscape(provisional_label)))
  cat(sprintf("<p style='margin: 10px 0; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px;'>%i SNPs and %i traits</p>\n", 
              n_snps[[cluster]], 
              n_traits[[cluster]]))

  cat("<div class='interpretation-card'>\n")
  cat("<h4>Initial interpretation</h4>\n")
  cat(sprintf("<p>%s</p>\n", htmltools::htmlEscape(narrative)))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Concentration:</strong> top locus %.1f%% of selected locus weight; top trait %.1f%% of total H loading energy; effective counts %.1f loci and %.1f traits.</p>\n",
    overview_row$top_locus_share_percent,
    overview_row$top_trait_share_percent,
    overview_row$effective_loci,
    overview_row$effective_traits
  ))
  cat("</div>\n\n")

  traits_display <- cluster_interpretation$top_traits[[cluster]] %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
  if (nrow(traits_display)) {
    cat("<h4>Defining signed traits</h4>\n")
    print(
      kable(traits_display,
            caption = "Positive/negative components are aligned to the primary-GWAS risk allele") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                      full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11)
    )
    cat("\n")
  }

  loci_display <- cluster_interpretation$top_loci[[cluster]]
  if (nrow(loci_display)) {
    if ("specificity" %in% names(loci_display)) {
      loci_display <- loci_display %>%
        mutate(specificity = scales::percent(specificity, accuracy = 0.1))
    }
    if ("weight" %in% names(loci_display)) loci_display$weight <- round(loci_display$weight, 4)
    if ("P_VALUE" %in% names(loci_display)) loci_display$P_VALUE <- signif(loci_display$P_VALUE, 3)
    cat("<h4>Defining loci and soft-membership specificity</h4>\n")
    print(
      kable(loci_display,
            caption = "Specificity is this cluster's weight divided by the locus's total weight across clusters") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                      full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10)
    )
    cat("\n")
  }

  domain_display <- cluster_interpretation$domains[[cluster]] %>%
    mutate(
      domain_weight = round(domain_weight, 4),
      weight_fraction = scales::percent(weight_fraction, accuracy = 0.1)
    ) %>%
    rename(Domain = domain, `Trait count` = n_traits,
           `Domain weight` = domain_weight, `Weight fraction` = weight_fraction) %>%
    select(-cluster)
  if (nrow(domain_display)) {
    cat("<h4>Trait-domain composition</h4>\n")
    print(
      kable(domain_display) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                      full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11)
    )
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  plots_to_display <- list(
    Circle = get_plot(my_circle_plots, cluster),
    Zmatrix = get_plot(my_zmats, cluster)
  )
  plots_to_display <- purrr::compact(plots_to_display)

  if (length(plots_to_display) > 0) {
    combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_to_display, ncol = 2)
    print(combined_plot)
  } else {
    cat("<p style='color: red;'>No valid plots available for this cluster</p>\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
